annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it presents a Forsage BUSD activation tutorial that directs viewers to sign in with a wallet, approve a referenced contract, and use a link to enable another level. It also asks viewers to copy a referral URL and connects it to the unclear, unverified claim of being “placed to the bank,” making the tutorial a crypto and recruitment solicitation.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The main content instructs viewers to activate successive X3/X4 levels, shows a multi-person partner structure, and links the referral process to being placed for earnings. This supports a tiered recruitment or matrix mechanism as the primary subtype.
